closureRequirements.missingEvidence: The exact iOS bare-ffmpeg framework exports FFmpeg av* symbols while declaring no FFmpeg dynamic-library dependency, which is evidence that LGPL-2.1-or-later FFmpeg code is statically embedded. The release inputs do not contain an approved LGPL distribution plan, the exact corresponding-source bundle, or the relinkable objects/relink mechanism for a recipient-modified FFmpeg build.
closureRequirements.action: Before distributing the binary, have qualified counsel or the publishing maintainer select and document an LGPL-2.1 compliance route; ship the required notices and license text, exact corresponding machine-readable source plus build scripts, and any relinkable object files or replacement mechanism that route requires, all byte-bound to this FFmpeg build. Do not treat license_reviewed=true by itself as closure evidence.

closureRequirements.missingEvidence: Bare 1.29.4 identifies the statically linked V8/libc++ archive only as Hyperdrive key krmguqnh75rud4iieqgmzyqoza415cbu68payoww65ii9fzt5n4o checkout 133. The public source does not map that immutable artifact to exact Chromium, V8, ICU, simdutf, and other bundled source revisions or ship their complete license payload.
closureRequirements.action: Obtain an upstream SBOM/NOTICE for BareKit v2.3.0 or a signed mapping from Hyperdrive checkout 133 to the exact chromium-prebuilds commit and complete third-party license set.

closureRequirements.missingEvidence: The npm artifacts contain prebuilt native binaries and human-readable component summaries, but no resolved vcpkg install manifest binding every transitive port to its source archive and no complete license-text payload. Some published NOTICE files are absent from the npm tarball and some label build-only qvac-lint-cpp as Unknown.
closureRequirements.action: Have the upstream addon build export its resolved iOS vcpkg dependency graph, source checksums, enabled features, and collected license files, then bind that report to each published prebuild digest.

closureRequirements.missingEvidence: Exact wrapper source pins are recoverable and several major child revisions are recorded above, but the npm tarballs do not include the complete child license/notice texts or a build-produced assertion that the enumerated children are the entire static closure.
closureRequirements.action: Collect license files from every directly fetched revision, include any nested static dependencies, and publish a build-generated closure manifest tied to each iOS prebuild SHA-256.
